episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hit Man

episodes.synopsis: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.
episodes.title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho

episodes.synopsis: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.
episodes.title: Welcome to Sugar Park

episodes.synopsis: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.
episodes.title: Hard-Boiled

episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.
episodes.title: Source of Strength

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.
episodes.title: Heisuke Mashimo

episodes.synopsis: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.
episodes.title: Jurassic Bastard

episodes.synopsis: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.
episodes.title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab

episodes.synopsis: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.
episodes.title: All Aboard

episodes.synopsis: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.
episodes.title: Bathhouse Roughhouse

episodes.synopsis: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way
episodes.title: Casino Battle
